diagnostics.message: Server action "actualizarEstadoProductos" performs unauthenticated privileged server work (.update()), so anyone can trigger it directly.
diagnostics.help: Check auth before changing server state or invoking billable services because exported server actions can be called directly by unauthenticated clients.

diagnostics.title: HTML injection sink with dynamic content
diagnostics.message: HTML is injected from a dynamic-looking source, which can become XSS if the value is user-controlled or unsanitized.
diagnostics.help: Prefer rendering structured React nodes. If HTML is required, sanitize with a well-reviewed sanitizer and keep the trust boundary close to the sink.

diagnostics.title: React function has high control-flow complexity
diagnostics.message: `DashboardPage` has cyclomatic complexity 23, cognitive complexity 33, and maximum nesting depth 3, so its React logic is hard to understand and change. Extract independent branches into components or hooks.
diagnostics.help: Extract independent render branches and state logic into focused components or hooks until the control flow is easy to follow.

diagnostics.title: Lazy image with high fetchPriority
diagnostics.message: `` defers the request while `fetchPriority="high"` asks the browser to rush it, so the two directives contradict each other. Drop one: keep `fetchPriority="high"` (and eager loading) for an LCP image, or `loading="lazy"` for a below-the-fold one.
diagnostics.help: Don't combine `loading="lazy"` with `fetchPriority="high"`. A high-priority image (usually the LCP) should load eagerly; a lazy image is by definition not high priority.

diagnostics.title: createObjectURL without revokeObjectURL
diagnostics.message: `URL.createObjectURL(...)` pins the underlying Blob/File in memory, and this produced URL is not provably revoked. Store the URL and pass that same value to `URL.revokeObjectURL` once you're done so the Blob can be freed.
diagnostics.help: Call `URL.revokeObjectURL(url)` once the object URL is no longer needed (after the download, in a `useEffect` cleanup, or on unmount). An object URL keeps its Blob/File alive for the document lifetime until it is revoked.

diagnostics.title: Sequential independent awaits
diagnostics.message: This awaited initializer does not read the previous result. If the operations are independent asynchronous work, they may overlap; await syntax alone does not establish a speedup.
diagnostics.help: Consider `Promise.all([...])` only for independent asynchronous work. Shared queues or synchronous work may not benefit. Preserve resource limits, transaction ordering, and failure/cancellation semantics.

diagnostics.title: Prop mirrored into state via effect
diagnostics.message: Your screen shows the old value first because useState "abierto" copies prop "mostrar" through this effect.
diagnostics.help: Delete both the `useState` and the `useEffect` and read the prop directly while rendering. Copying a prop into state shows the old value on the first render before the effect catches up.

diagnostics.title: Unguarded call to a throwing parse API
diagnostics.message: This builds a `URL` from a runtime URL/route value (`params`, `searchParams`, a `location` field), which throws `TypeError` on a malformed string and crashes render. Guard it with `URL.canParse`, pass a base-URL second argument, or wrap the call in a try/catch.
diagnostics.help: `decodeURIComponent`/`decodeURI`, color parsers (`readableColor`/`parseToRgb`/`chroma`), and single-arg `new URL(x)` on a URL/route value throw on malformed runtime input and crash render; guard with a validity pre-check (`URL.canParse`, `chroma.valid`), a try/catch, or a `safe*` helper that returns a fallback.
